1 · Intro

When to use it.

Costing tells Oracle which accounts pay for a person's salary. Each payroll run turns pay into costing results that move to the General Ledger, so wrong costing means wrong department and grant financials.

Fixing costing after payroll runs takes extra processing, so getting it right up front saves everyone time.

Use this whenYou set up or review costing for a hire, transfer, or funding change, or a finance partner questions where salary was charged.

2 · Walk through

How costing flows.

Check off each item as you read.

Watch-outs

  • After a BU transfer, costing does not reset on its own. Review it every time.
  • Blank costing is not wrong by itself; it means the work unit default applies. Confirm the default is the account you want.
  • Open item: confirm how Vanderbilt handles grant labor distribution and the deadline to fix costing before a payroll run.

HCM Academy job aid · Costing Management

How employee costing impacts payroll and financial reporting

Use when: You set up or review costing for a hire, transfer, or funding change, or a finance partner questions where salary was charged. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Costing is set in Costing for Persons.
  2. Oracle uses the most specific level first: element, then assignment, then work unit default.
    • Element > Assignment > Work unit default
  3. Payroll creates costing results, then transfers them to the General Ledger.
  4. Grant-funded salary depends on correct splits.
  5. Costing follows a person who transfers business units; review it.
  6. Late fixes go through cost adjustments or retroactive costing.
  7. Check your area with the Departmental Playbook reports.

Watch-outs

  • After a BU transfer, costing does not reset on its own. Review it every time.
  • Blank costing is not wrong by itself; it means the work unit default applies. Confirm the default is the account you want.
  • Open item: confirm how Vanderbilt handles grant labor distribution and the deadline to fix costing before a payroll run.
